title: Fire in Weld County producing smoke, affecting Greeley
snippet: A fire in Weld County is producing significant amounts of smoke, and has created hazy, smoky conditions in areas near Greeley. Monitors are showing a rapid rise in fine particulate concentrations in Greeley and Evans. Folks in these areas should remain aware of potential health impacts due to smoke.
